env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Views follow aggregate stores, with Go copies and reference sharing.
# Compile-time results agree with ordinary execution and ejected Go.
cd m
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/ctfe_assignment_storage.lgo main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/ctfe_assignment_storage.out expected.txt
logos run .
cmp stdout expected.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt
exists $UPROOT1274/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1274/bin/go run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ctfestorage

go 1.27
-- m/logos.toml --
[build]
arena = false
target_cpu = "baseline"
